I've set up a daily 09:15 job for the 'North morning digest', but it isn't live yet and I can't promise a post tomorrow.

The scheduler isn't running on my side. Until someone starts it, the job is saved but won't fire. I said this in #north-team, but I haven't contacted anyone about getting it started.

Once it runs, each morning it will read #north-team and #inc-qfl-sev1 for the previous day and post a short digest in #north-team. Dana, Marcus and you are all in both channels, so nobody sees anything they couldn't already see. If that membership changes, the digest will leave the incident section out and say so.
